notes.title: The Holiday Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309499/26f9b3b115b84dc47b3c386f4fd134fd1bbd437f.png
New Episode: Frozen Peaks    8 New Levels!    1 New Boss    2 New Cosmetics    New Enemy: Snowman    New Enemy: NutcrackerGameplay Changes    Score ranking system updated.Enemy ChangesSniper:    The laser now changes color when the sniper fires a round.Woodsman:    Tweaked parry animation.    Fixed a bug preventing him from hurting enemies.    Complete rework to his charge mechanic:                    You can now dodge his swing.            He will no longer reflect projectiles unless he is charging.            He can no longer hit you from behind.            Power-up ChangesBunny Ears:    Reset time increased from 0.5 to 1.3 seconds.    Cooldown timer increased from 0.3 to 0.5 seconds.Hero ChangesBlue:    Blue is now affected by Haste.    Reflected projectiles now deal 5% of the original owner’s health as damage.                    (This improves Blue’s ability to take down bosses.)            UI Changes    Player outlines added.    Enemy outlines added.    Pickup outlines added.    Settings menu now closes during gameplay.    Gameplay tab in the settings menu reorganized.Boss Changes    Zepharius now behaves differently when playing as Blue.Map Changes    E1M12: Arrow now points correctly.    E2M21: Added an extra platform.    E3M3: Added some extra goodies.    E3M21: Added a guiding sign (sorry about that!).    E3M23: Fixed some graphical errors.    E4M7: Added some extra goodies.    E4M17: Adjusted the rising platform near the exit.    E4M19: Changes made to the infamous platform.    E4M22: Added a Blue-exclusive power-up.    Lasers now hurt enemies.Bug Fixes    Fixed a bug in level select that loaded the incorrect save file.    Fixed a bug causing episodes to unlock and lock incorrectly.    Fixed a bug where music restarted on retry or level change.    Fixed a bug where the cosmetics tab would load incorrectly for save files with Blue.    Fixed an issue where Bunny Ears triggered excessively on sloped floors.    Fixed an oversight where you always received max arrows.    Boss music no longer restarts on death.Miscellaneous    Added an Easter egg.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309499/bf35eeb21012b72540bd4e62f6e44cf770e18410.png
